# diagrid_kvstore (Resource)

Diagrid KVStore resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "diagrid_project" "example" {
  name = "example-project"
}

resource "diagrid_kvstore" "example" {
  project_name     = diagrid_project.example.name
  name             = "my-kvstore"
  component_name   = "my-kvstore-component"
  create_component = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `component_name` (String) Component name
- `name` (String) KVStore name
- `project_name` (String) Project name

### Optional

- `create_component` (Boolean) Create component
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes

### Read-Only

- `status` (String) Status
